title: 1993 AHSME Problem 5
statement: Last year a bicycle cost \(\$160\) and a cycling helmet cost \(\$40.\) This year the cost of the bicycle increased by \(5\%,\) and the cost of the helmet increased by \(10\%.\) The percent increase in the combined cost of the bicycle and the helmet is

solutions.text: The bicycle increases by \(\$8\) and the helmet by \(\$4,\) for a total increase of \(\$12.\) Last year’s combined cost was \(\$200,\) so the percent increase is \[ \frac{12}{200}\cdot100\%=6\%. \] Thus the correct answer is A.
hints: Find the dollar increase for each item
Compare the total increase with last year’s combined cost
